nodes.label: RLS Data Isolation
nodes.rationale: Database queries must run with each user's JWT so Supabase RLS can evaluate auth.uid() and isolate task data.

nodes.label: Vite Environment Variable Prefix
nodes.rationale: Client-side variables use the VITE_ prefix because Vite otherwise does not expose them to browser code.

nodes.label: Resilient E2E Assertions
nodes.rationale: Registration tests accept both duplicate-email errors and successful redirects because Supabase may conceal existing accounts to prevent email enumeration.

nodes.label: Subscription Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Paid plans require recurring checkout, subscription and usage records, backend limit enforcement, and frontend premium-feature gates.

nodes.label: Kolium Technology Architecture
nodes.rationale: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Supabase, Vitest, and Playwright were chosen for rapid development, modern managed infrastructure, and reliable testing.

nodes.label: Vercel SPA Rewrite
nodes.rationale: Rewriting all paths to index.html preserves client-side routing for password-reset and authentication callback URLs.

nodes.label: Debugging Documentation Loop
nodes.rationale: When debugging stalls, add diagnostic logging, document the issue, root cause, and solution in ISSUES_FIXED.md, then remove unnecessary logs.
